spans.s:
अश्रः A corner, mostly at the end
of comp.; चतुरश्र, त्र्यश्र &c.
--श्रं [
अश्नुते नेत्रं, अश्-रक्]
1 A tear.
--2
Blood (usually written अस्र q. v.).
--Comp.
--पः a blood-drinker, a
fiend, cannibal.

अस्रः [अस्-रन्]
1 A corner, an
angle.
--2 Hair of the head.
--स्रं
1 Tear; अस्रोत्तरमीक्षितामिमां

.
--2 Blood.
--Comp.
--अर्जक a.
producing blood.
--(कः) {1} the white
Tulasī plant. {2} the humour
producing blood.
--कंठः [अस्रः
कोणः इव कंठोऽस्य] an arrow.
--खदिरः
the red Mimosa.
--जं flesh.
--जित् =
अश्रजित् q. v.
--पः {1} ‘a blood-drinker’,
a Rākṣasa or goblin; वध्यंतेऽ
स्रपपुंगवाः

. {2} the Nakṣatra
मूला.
--पा {1} a leech. {2} a Ḍākinī
or female imp.
--पत्रकः N. of a
plant (भिंडावृक्ष).
--पित्तं hemorrhage,
involuntary discharge of blood
from the mouth, nostrils &c.
--फला,
--ली N. of a plant (सल्लकी).
--मातृका
chyle, chyme.
--रोधिनी the plant
लज्जालु Mimosa Pudica.
--बिंदुच्छदा N.
of a tuberous plant (लक्षणावृक्ष).
अश्रिन् a. Having tears, in tears.

अश्रद्ध a. Without faith,
unbelieving, diffident.
--द्धा Unbelief,
diffidence.

अश्राद्ध a. Not performing the
Śrāddha ceremony; not entitled to
it, not belonging or relating to it.
--द्धः Non-performance of a Śrāddha
q. v.
--Comp.
--भोजिन् a. one who has
vowed not to eat during the
performance of a Śrāddha ceremony.

अश्रद्धेय a. Not to be believed,
incredible.

अश्रम a. Ved. Indefatigable,
untiring.
--मः
1 Freedom from fatigue,
freshness, vigour.
--2 Absence of
toil, laziness.

अश्रमण a. Indefatigable.
--णः
One who is not an ascetic or
Buddhist mendicant.

अश्रांत a.
1 Unwearied, not
fatigued, untired.
--2 Incessant,
continual; अश्रांतपुण्यकर्माणः

.
--तं Absence of rest.
--तं ind.
Incessantly, continually;
मयूखैरश्रांतं तपति यदि देवो दिनकरः

अश्रवण a. Deaf, having no ears.
--णः A snake.
--णं Loss of hearing,
deafness.

अश्राव्य a.
1 Not to be heard.
--2
Unfit to be heard, not be spoken of.

अश्रातस् ind. Ved. In an
uncooked manner, raw.

अश्रिः --श्री f. [अश्यते संहन्यते अनया
अश् वंक्र्यादि˚ क्रि; cf.

]
1 A
corner, angle (of a room, house &c.)
(changed to अश्र at the end of
comp. with चतुर्, त्रि, षट् and a few
other words; see चतुरस्र);
--अष्टाश्रिर्वै
[]
वज्रः Ait. Br.
--2 The sharp side
or edge (of a weapon &c.); वृत्रस्य
हंतुः कुलिशं कुंठिताश्रीव लक्ष्यते

1 An angle.
--2 Ten
millions; see अश्रि.
आश्रिः f. The edge of a sword.

अश्रिः --श्री f. [अश्यते संहन्यते अनया
अश् वंक्र्यादि˚ क्रि; cf.

]
1 A
corner, angle (of a room, house &c.)
(changed to अश्र at the end of
comp. with चतुर्, त्रि, षट् and a few
other words; see चतुरस्र);
--अष्टाश्रिर्वै
[]
वज्रः Ait. Br.
--2 The sharp side
or edge (of a weapon &c.); वृत्रस्य
हंतुः कुलिशं कुंठिताश्रीव लक्ष्यते

(a) To resort or
betake oneself to; to have
recourse to (a place, way, course
of action &c.);
विचरितमृगयूथान्याश्रयिष्ये वनानि

fell on the
ground; 17. 92; वृतिमाश्रित्य वैतसीं

resorting to or following;
so धैर्यं, शोकं, बलं, मित्रभावं,
संस्कृतमाश्रित्य &c.; आश्रित्य having recourse or
reference; तामाश्रि य

;
कततत्प्रकरणमाश्रित्य गीयतां Ś. 1 (b) To seek
refuge with, dwell with or in,
inhabit (as a place &c); शरण्यमेनमाश्रयन्ते

; सर्वे
गुणाः कांचनमाश्रयंत्।.
--2 To go through,
experience; एकोरसः…
पृथक्पृथगिवाश्रयते विवर्तान्

.
--3 To rest or
depend upon.
--4 To adhere or stick to,
fall to the lot of, happen, occur;
पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्

we shall incur
[]
sin.
--5 To choose, prefer.
--6 To
assist, help.
अश्रित a. Ved. Difficult of access.

आश्रित p. p. (Used actively)
(with an acc.)
1 Resorting to,
having recourse to; स किलाश्रममंत्यमाश्रितः

.
--2
Dwelling in, inhabiting, seated or
resting on, stationing oneself at or
on; इदं स्फटिकतलमाश्रितो भवामि

; so वातायनमाश्रितः पश्यति;
द्रव्याश्रितो गुणः Ak.;

.
--5 Receiving
anything as an inherent or integral
part.
--6 Dependent on; राष्ट्रं
बाहुबलाश्रितं

.
--7 Referring to,
regarding; भीष्माश्रिताः कथाः Mb.
--8 (Passively used) Resorted to,
inhabited &c.; चटकाश्रिता शाखा

.
--तं (pl.) The objects perceived
by the senses and mind.

अश्रीक a.
1 Having no
splendour, without beauty, pale;
Śi. 15. 96.
--2 Unlucky, unpropitious, not
prosperous.

]
A tear; पपात भूमौ सह सैनिकाश्रुभिः

. [cf. Zend asru; Pers. ars.].
--Comp.
--उपहत a. affected by
tears, covered with tears.
--कला a
tear-drop.
--नाली Fistula
Lachrymalis.
--परिपूर्ण a. filled with tears;
˚अक्ष having eyes filled with tears.
--परिप्लुत a. suffused or filled with
tears, bathed in tears.
--पातः flow
of tears, shedding tears.
--पूर्ण a.
filled with tears; ˚आकुल troubled
and filled with tears;

.
--मुख a. suffused with tears,
(suddenly) bursting into tears;
एकपदेऽश्रुमुखी संवृत्ता

.
--लोचन, --नेत्र
a. with tears in the eyes, with
tearful eyes.
--शालिन् a. having tears,
tearful.

To hear, listen
to.
--2 To promise (with dat. of
person; cf.

To cause to hear.
--2 To call, particularly in ritualistic
formulas; ओमित्याश्रावयति Ch. Up.
--3 To draw towards, win over,
attract;

अश्रुत a.
1 Unheard,
inaudible.
--2 Contrary to the Vedas.
--3
Not acquainted with the Śāstras,
foolish, uneducated; भागं
विद्याधनात्तस्मात् स लभेताश्रुतोऽपि सन् Dāy. B.

आश्रुत p. p.
1 Heard.
--2
Promised, agreed, accepted.
--तं
Calling so as to make one listen.

अश्रौत a. Not sanctioned by the
Vedas.

अश्रुति a. Without ears.
--तिः f.
Not hearing, forgetfulness;
अश्रुतिमभिनीय

.
--Comp.
--धर a. {1} not
striking the ear or attention. {2}
not knowing the Vedas.

अश्रेष्ठ a. Not the best, inferior,
worse; bad, vile.
अस्रायते Den. A. To shed tears.

अस्रिध्, अस्त्रेधत् a. Ved. Devout,
faithful.

आस्रं [अस्रमेव स्वार्थेऽण्] Blood.
--Comp.
--पः {1} ‘blood-drinker’,
demon. {2} the 19th lunar mansion.

आश्रपणं [आ-श्रा-णिच् ल्युट्] The
act of cooking or boiling.

आश्रमः, --मं [आ-श्रम् आधारे घञ् वृद्ध्य
भावः]
1 A hermitage, hut, cell,
dwelling or abode of ascetics.
--2 A
stage, order, or period of the
(religious) life of a Brāhmaṇa. These
are four:
--ब्रह्मचर्य the life of a student;
गार्हस्थ्य the life of a house holder:
वानप्रस्य the life of an anchorite or
hermit, and संन्यास the life of a
[]
Bhikṣu or beggar. Kṣatriyas (and
Vaiśyas also) can enter upon the
first three Āśramas; cf. Ś. 7. 20;

.
--3 A
college, school.
--4 A wood or thicket
(where ascetics practise penance).
--5 N. of Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--गुरुः
the head of a religious order, a
preceptor, principal.
--धर्मः {1} the
special duties of each order or life.
{2} the duties of one leading a
hermit's life; य इमामाश्रमधर्मे नियुङ्क्ते Ś. 1.
--पदं, --मंडलं, --स्थानं {1} a hermitage
(including the surrounding grounds),
a penance forest (तपोवनं);
शांतमिदमाश्रमपदं Ś. 1. 16. {2} a period in the
religious life of a Brāhmaṇa.
--भ्रष्ट a. fallen from any religious
order, apostate.
--वासः residence in
a hermitage.
--वासिक a. relating to
residence in a hermitage; ˚कं पर्व
the 15th book of the Mb.
--वासिन्,
--आलयः, --सद् m. an ascetic, hermit.

आश्रमः, --मं [आ-श्रम् आधारे घञ् वृद्ध्य
भावः]
1 A hermitage, hut, cell,
dwelling or abode of ascetics.
--2 A
stage, order, or period of the
(religious) life of a Brāhmaṇa. These
are four:
--ब्रह्मचर्य the life of a student;
गार्हस्थ्य the life of a house holder:
वानप्रस्य the life of an anchorite or
hermit, and संन्यास the life of a
[]
Bhikṣu or beggar. Kṣatriyas (and
Vaiśyas also) can enter upon the
first three Āśramas; cf. Ś. 7. 20;

.
--3 A
college, school.
--4 A wood or thicket
(where ascetics practise penance).
--5 N. of Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--गुरुः
the head of a religious order, a
preceptor, principal.
--धर्मः {1} the
special duties of each order or life.
{2} the duties of one leading a
hermit's life; य इमामाश्रमधर्मे नियुङ्क्ते Ś. 1.
--पदं, --मंडलं, --स्थानं {1} a hermitage
(including the surrounding grounds),
a penance forest (तपोवनं);
शांतमिदमाश्रमपदं Ś. 1. 16. {2} a period in the
religious life of a Brāhmaṇa.
--भ्रष्ट a. fallen from any religious
order, apostate.
--वासः residence in
a hermitage.
--वासिक a. relating to
residence in a hermitage; ˚कं पर्व
the 15th book of the Mb.
--वासिन्,
--आलयः, --सद् m. an ascetic, hermit.

आश्रमिक a., आश्रमिन् a. [आश्रम-ठन्
इति]
1 Belonging to one of the four
orders or periods of religious life;

1 Stream, river.
--2
Fault, transgression; see आस्रव and
under आश्रु also.

आस्रवः [आस्रु-अप्]
1 Pain,
affliction, distress.
--2 Flowing,
running.
--3 Discharge,
emission.
--4 Fault, transgression.
--5
The foam on boiling rice.
--6 (With
Jainas) The impulse called योग or
attention which the soul
participates in the movement of its
various bodies; it is defined as the
‘action of the senses which impels the
soul towards external objects’; it
is good or evil according as it is
directed towards good or evil
objects.

आश्रयः [आश्रि-अच्]
1 A
restingplace, seat, substratum;
सौहृदादपृथगाश्रयामिमां

v. l.; so
आश्रयासिद्ध q. v. below.
--2 That on which
anything depends or rests, or
with which it is closely
connected.
--3 Recipient, receptacle, a
person or thing in which any
quality is present or retained &c.;
तमाश्रयं दुष्प्रसहस्य तेजसः

. (b) A dwelling, house.
--5
Having recourse or resort to, resort;
oft. in comp. साभूद्रामाश्रया भूयः

.
--7
Choosing, taking, attaching oneself
to.
--8 Dependence on; oft. in comp.;
मम सर्वे विषयास्त्वदाश्रयाः

.
--9
Patron, supporter; विनाश्रयं न तिष्ठंति
पंडिता वनिता लताः Udb.
--10 A prop,
support;

.
--11 Help,
assistance, protection.
--12 A quiver;
बाणमाश्रयमुखात् समुद्धरन्

.
--13 Authority, sanction, warrant.
--14 Connection, relation,
association.
--15 Union, attachment.
--16
A plea, an excuse.
--17 Contiguity,
vicinity.
--18 Seeking shelter or
protection with another (= संश्रय),
one of the six gunas, q. v.
--19 An
appropriate act, or one consistent
with character.
--20 Source, origin.
--21 (In gram.) The subject, or that
to which the predicate is attached.
--22 (With Buddhists) The five
organs of sense with Manas or
mind.
--Comp.
--असिद्धः, --द्धिः f. a
kind of fallacy, one of the three
sub-divisions of असिद्ध; (that whose
substratum is false or fictitious);
e. g. गगमारनिंदं सुरभि अरविंदत्व
त्सरोजारविंदवत्.
--आशः, --भुज् a. consuming
every thing with which it comes
in contact.
--(शः, --क्) {1} fire;
दुर्वृत्तः क्रियते धूर्तैः श्रीमानात्मविवृद्धये ।
किं नाम खलसंसर्गः कुरुते नाश्रयाशवत् ॥
Udb. {2} a forfeiter of asylum. {3}
the constellation कृत्तिका.
--भूत a. one
who is the refuge or support (of
another person).
--लिंगं an adjective
(a word which must agree in gender
[]
with the word which it qualifies or
refers to).

.
--2 Referring to.
--णं
1 Betaking
oneself to, taking refuge with.
--2
Accepting, choosing.
--3 Joining.
--4
Refuge, asylum.

आश्रयिन् a.
1 Resting with,
dependent on.
--2 Related to, concerning;
तदाश्रयिणी कथा

.
--वः
1 A promise,
engagement.
--2 Fault,
transgression.
--3 One of the categories
according to the Jainas; see आस्रव.

आस्राव a. Flowing, running.
--वः
1 A wound.
--2 Flow, issue,
discharge.
--3 Spittle, saliva.
--4 Pain,
affliction.
--5 A disease of the body.
--Comp.
--भेषजं medicament,
medicine.

1 Calling out so as to
make one listen.
--2 N. of certain
short words uttered at ceremonies;
ॐ स्वधेत्याश्रावणमस्तु स्वधेति प्रत्याश्रावणं
Āśval.

आश्रुकर्ण a. One whose ears hear
all around (Ved.).

आस्राविन् a. Flowing, emitting
fluid or humour; an epithet of
the elephant when ichor is issuing
from its temples.
